summary: Elevate your short-term rental game with our expert training course. Learn to manage properties on Airbnb and VRBO effectively. Enroll today for success!
lede: Airbnb property management training covers the systems and decisions involved in running short-term rental portfolios. It develops skills in tracking occupancy and revenue, setting dynamic prices, coordinating distribution across booking channels, and building repeatable guest communication, turnover and maintenance workflows. The material is suited to experienced portfolio managers, operations directors and revenue professionals responsible for coordinating multiple properties and measuring performance.
audienceIntro: This program is tailored for experienced professionals seeking to professionalize their approach to short-term rental assets and scale their operations globally.
modules: STR Market Intelligence and Performance Metrics
Advanced Tech Stack and PMS Integration
prerequisites: Participants should have at least 2 years of experience in property management, real estate, or hospitality operations. Familiarity with at least one major OTA (Airbnb or VRBO) and basic proficiency in Microsoft Excel for financial modeling is required. Prior experience with a Property Management System (PMS) is recommended but not mandatory.
